title: Pro Shop Store Credit: dues-standing gate on a redemption
content:
## Applies to
Pro Shop Store Credit: this document covers the dues-standing condition on a Pro Shop Store Credit redemption, for every tier of this product.

## Basis
Redemption is permitted at all only while the member's separately-held club membership account currently carries no outstanding dues balance. Where that membership account's dues balance is greater than zero, nothing is redeemed for this request, regardless of the account's own current balance or the space otherwise available under the tier's redemption ceiling. What is redeemed, once permitted, is rounded to two decimal places.
